sn17.6:1.3: The imperative verbs _āgacchatu_ and _anupāpuṇātu_ seem incomprehensible. Why would the Buddha say a person *should* be struck by the lightning of possessions, honor, and popularity? Read as simple present. | _Asanivicakkaṁ_ is “forked lightning”, see Rig Veda 4.35.2 where _vicakra_ means “divided”.
